2025_068_september_2025_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) report for September 2025 itemizes district PCARD charges posted between 8/26/2025 and 9/25/2025, each carrying the journal entry description SEP 2025 PCARD EXP and coded to a business unit number and an account number. Printed 11/6/2025 and carried on the November 18, 2025 Board of Education agenda, the listing closes with a stated total of 340,669.59. The largest single line is 7,717.70 to INSTRUCTURE on 9/9/2025 (B.U. 101203131373000, account 3450). Amazon merchant codes account for the majority of the individual entries.
2025_068_september_2025_pcard_report.page:
## What this is
A line-by-line register of Troy School District purchasing-card (PCARD) activity for September 2025, printed 11/6/2025 and included with the November 18, 2025 board meeting materials. Every page repeats the heading TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, September 2025 and the column labels: Line item decrip / J E descrip / B.U.# / Account / Transaction Amount. The final page is numbered 46.

## Format and period
Each row combines a posting date and a truncated merchant name (for example 9/9/2025-INSTRUCTURE, or 8/26/2025-AMAZON MKTPL), the uniform journal description SEP 2025 PCARD EXP, a fifteen-digit business unit code, a four-digit account code, and the amount. Dates range from 8/26/2025 through 9/25/2025. Credits appear in parentheses; a few rows show a dash in place of an amount (CURRIC ASSO on 8/26/2025 posted to 122013122150000, 122015122150000 and 122885122326000, and AMAZON MARK* posted to 122070122110000).

## Stated total
The report ends with a single printed figure: **340,669.59**.

### Document identity and layout
The September 2025 PCARD report of the Troy School District is a printed transaction register produced on 11/6/2025 and carried on the November 18, 2025 Board of Education agenda. Each of its pages repeats the title line TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, September 2025 followed by the column header Line item decrip / J E descrip / B.U.# / Account / Transaction Amount; the final page is numbered 46. Every row bears the identical journal entry description SEP 2025 PCARD EXP. The line item description field concatenates the posting date with a truncated merchant descriptor as it arrived from the card processor (for example 9/9/2025-INSTRUCTURE, 8/26/2025-AMAZON MKTPL, 9/4/2025-DRP*DRAPER I, 9/15/2025-DBC*BLICK AR). Posting dates run from 8/26/2025 through 9/25/2025. Amounts in parentheses are credits. A handful of rows carry a dash instead of a figure: CURRIC ASSO on 8/26/2025 against 122013122150000, 122015122150000 and 122885122326000, and AMAZON MARK* on 8/27/2025 against 122070122110000. The report closes with one printed figure, 340,669.59.
